summary: 60-foot Aermotor tower beside a Georgia Forestry Commission office in Dahlonega, erected in the late 1950s or early 1960s and kept up by the office though no longer in use.

facts.status_note: Standing and maintained by the forestry office; no longer in active use.

access.note: Signed as state property; office staff escort visitors up the tower.

visit.trail_note: Arrange a visit through the Lumpkin County forestry office; staff escort visitors up the tower.

events.note: Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register March 14, 2019

evidence.supports: 60-foot Aermotor tower beside a Georgia Forestry Commission office in Dahlonega
evidence.quote: This 60-foot Aermotor tower stands beside a Georgia Forestry Commission office in Dahlonega, Georgia.

evidence.supports: Tower predates the office; erected late 1950s or early 1960s
evidence.quote: The tower predates the office and the workshop on site, having been erected sometime in the late 1950s or early 1960s.

evidence.supports: No longer in active use but maintained by the office
evidence.quote: It is no longer in active use but continues to be maintained by the office.

evidence.supports: Signed as state property; office staff escort visitors up the tower
evidence.quote: The tower is signed as state property, but the office staff will escort visitors up the tower.

evidence.supports: Location is the Lumpkin County forestry office
Georgia tower list codes it gfc-918 in Lumpkin County

notes_for_editor: The register gives only a range (late 1950s to early 1960s) for the build, so no built event is recorded. The register's coordinates place the tower at the forestry office rather than on a summit. Elevation: register 1,721 ft (525 m), tnlandforms 1715 ft; the record's 524.6 m is consistent. Visit terms (staff escort) and the 'no longer in active use' status come from the March 2019 register entry and are undated; confirm with the Lumpkin County forestry office before publishing.
